```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(writexl)

setwd("/Users/camerongreene/Dropbox (Personal)/2. Seth/super-api")
```

## Load raw output

```{r load}
df <- read_excel("superintendents_2025-2026_processed.xlsx")
cat("Rows loaded:", nrow(df), "\n")
```

## Replace UNKNOWN with NA

```{r unknown-to-na}
n_unknown <- sum(df$superintendent == "UNKNOWN", na.rm = TRUE)
cat("UNKNOWN records before replacement:", n_unknown, "\n")

df <- df %>%
  mutate(superintendent = case_when(
    superintendent == "UNKNOWN" ~ "NA",
    is.na(superintendent)       ~ "NA",
    TRUE                        ~ superintendent
  ))

cat("NA records after replacement:", sum(is.na(df$superintendent)), "\n")
```

## Ensure NYC Chancellor row is present

The NYC Department of Education reports as a single agency (LEAID 3620580) but the
automated pipeline processes its 32 geographic sub-districts individually. We add one
row for the Chancellor so the top-level agency is represented.

```{r nyc-chancellor}
nyc_leaid <- "3620580"

if (!nyc_leaid %in% as.character(df$LEAID)) {
  chancellor_row <- tibble(
    LEAID                   = nyc_leaid,
    district_name           = "NYC Chancellor of Education",
    district_state          = "NEW YORK",
    superintendent          = "Kamar Samuels",
    source_url_1            = NA_character_,
    source_url_2            = NA_character_,
    certainty               = NA_character_,
    found_on_district_website   = NA_character_,
    title_is_superintendent     = NA_character_,
    source_current_school_year  = NA_character_,
    multiple_sources_agree      = NA_character_,
    conflicting_info_found      = NA_character_,
    structural_uncertainty      = NA_character_,
    superintendent_transition   = NA_character_,
    district_website_accessible = NA_character_,
    justification_main          = NA_character_,
    justification_verification  = NA_character_,
    justification_judge         = NA_character_,
    source_date             = NA,
    MCITY                   = NA_character_,
    MSTREET1                = NA_character_,
    MZIP                    = NA_real_,
    SY_STATUS_TEXT          = NA_character_,
    LEA_TYPE                = NA_real_,
    LEA_TYPE_TEXT           = NA_character_,
    LEVEL                   = NA_character_,
    WEBSITE                 = NA_character_,
    OPERATIONAL_SCHOOLS     = NA_real_
  )
  df <- bind_rows(df, chancellor_row)
  cat("NYC Chancellor row added (LEAID", nyc_leaid, ")\n")
} else {
  cat("NYC Chancellor row already present (LEAID", nyc_leaid, ") — no change.\n")
}
```

## Save

```{r save}
write_xlsx(df, "superintendents_2025-2026_processed.xlsx")
cat("Saved:", nrow(df), "rows to superintendents_2025-2026_processed.xlsx\n")
cat("Named superintendents:", sum(!is.na(df$superintendent)), "\n")
cat("NA (was UNKNOWN):", sum(is.na(df$superintendent)), "\n")
```
